title: Adopt the AJAX MessageCommand for file upload errors
description: Replay the Article form with the Attachment file field, reach the starting state the issue is about, and capture the file widget. The upload that produces the validation error needs a file input, which this data-step representation does not provide, so the error state itself is not reached here: the scenario records the reachable start state and the gap, and tools/playwright/evaluate-3618230.mjs performs the real upload on both sides.
preconditions: Standard install with the Article content type and a file field with a 1 KB size limit (recipe repro_3618230, core fixture recipes).
Variant 3618230-pinned is built: Before envs/baseline-3618230, After envs/issue-3618230. After carries the MR !16777 patch.
A file larger than 1 KB is available to the host-side evaluator; a scenario replay cannot attach files.

fixture.notes: recipes/repro_3618230/ exists (config plus recipe.yml built from core's article_content_type and file_field_with_size_limit fixtures). It adds the Attachment file field with the size limit; it does not include a file to upload.

steps.label: Open the Add Article form and wait for the file widget
The Attachment file widget is present
Read the file inputs and the upload-message containers (read-only)
The file widget's scope was found on the page

checkpoints.label: The Attachment file widget is present

resetInstructions: node scripts/lab-env.mjs reset 3618230-pinned --yes (the real upload leaves a file row and a message; reset restores the fixture)
manualReview: Upload a file larger than the 1 KB limit in each frame and check that the error is inside the Attachment widget's .file-upload-messages container, not the page message region.

Check that the error has a working Hide button, reachable by keyboard, and that the error text is announced (the MR also calls Drupal.announce while the message keeps role=alert, so a screen reader may say it twice).
Check the second over-limit upload replaces the error instead of piling up a second one, and that a valid upload clears it.
A real keyboard and screen-reader pass on the upload flow.
limits: The upload error state is NOT reached: there is no file-input step in the scenario vocabulary and a state-changing evaluate callback is not allowed. The scenario stops at the file widget and records the gap; the real flow is tools/playwright/evaluate-3618230.mjs (setInputFiles).
The pinned core pair was never run for the original evidence (reports/issues/3618230/EVIDENCE.md covers the -latest pair); the pinned recipe is a precondition, not a verified state.
The possible double announcement (role=alert plus Drupal.announce) needs a screen reader.
The scenario has not been replayed in this session; no Drupal site was running.
notes: Read reports/issues/3618230/EVIDENCE.md, REPRODUCE.md, recipes/repro_3618230/recipe.yml and tools/playwright/evaluate-3618230.mjs.
